assessments.reasoning: Section 6.11 item l on physical page 63 explicitly requires a kernel function to return void. The exact same-revision manuscript reproduces that line.

challenge.method: Read the section opening on page 62, the particular kernel-qualified sentence on page 63, and compare against the independently fetched OpenCL_C.txt.
challenge.results: The restriction is on a kernel function. The general restrictions list gives no basis to extend this line to every helper or host function.

limitations: This documentary result applies to the cited v3.0.19 specification. No compiler acceptance experiment was performed.
